Data quality

Saved on this device

Analysis history

Planner, NVV and potential-rehandle results come from every saved WI batch. Yard Inventory remains optional.

Planning dateTerminalVesselsNetwork / SSPlanner movesNVV exceptionsRehandles

No saved analyses yet.

01

Planner moves

Each valid LOAD or DSCH row is assigned to the WI Planner. Batch totals combine all selected Work Lists.

02

Short steaming

Short steaming is selected manually for each detected vessel. GEN_CARRIER never marks a vessel as SS.

03

Optional yard

Work Lists alone calculate planner KPIs, NVV and potential rehandles. A yard snapshot adds only the independent inventory view and source cross-checks.

04

NVV source

Discharge FCL rows use WI POD, Category, Line and Outbound Carrier. MTY and restows are excluded; HLC GEN/Truck transhipments are treated as ITT.

05

Rehandle model

Each vessel is evaluated separately using WI current stack/tier and planned load order. Results are Possible or Probable—not confirmed without historical yard evidence.

06

Local processing

Files are read inside this browser. History stores calculated results, not the uploaded source files.
